source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-43

procedures.title: Directional signal switch: replace (Corvette standard and telescoping column)
steps: Cut the switch wiring just above the connector.
Remove the 3 switch mounting screws; slide the switch, cover and upper bearing housing off the column, drawing the wires out through the protector and escutcheon.
For the new switch, take off the harness connector supplied on its wiring.
Fit the upper bearing housing and signal switch into the switch cover.
Thread the wiring through the escutcheon and protector until the switch sits on the mast jacket.
With the switch on the mast jacket, install the 3 mounting screws.
Fit the thrust and wave washers and snap the lock ring into place.
Install the turn signal lever and the hazard warning knob.
Fit the cancelling cam and the upper bearing preload spring on the steering shaft.
Install the steering wheel, with the directional signal switch in neutral first.
Fit the connector to the directional signal harness and plug it into the body harness connector.

procedures.title: Wiper transmission: remove and install
steps: Make sure the wiper motor is parked.
Open the hood.
Corvette only: pull the rubber plug from the front of the wiper door actuator, insert a screwdriver and push the internal piston rearward to open the wiper door.
Take the wiper arm and blade assemblies off the transmission; on articulated left-hand arms, remove the carburetor-type clip holding the pinned arm to the blade arm.
Remove the plenum chamber air intake grille or screen, if fitted.
Loosen the nuts holding the drive rod ball stud to the crank arm and detach the drive rod.
Remove the transmission screws or nuts and drop the transmission and drive rods into the plenum chamber.
Lift the transmission and linkage out through the cowl opening.
Install in reverse order, with the blades in Park position within 3/8 in. of the reveal molding stop on recessed arms.
notes: See figure 58 in the manual (wiper and motor linkage).

procedures.title: Wiper motor: remove and install
steps: Make sure the wiper motor is parked.
Open the hood.
Disconnect the washer hoses and the electrical connectors from the motor.
Remove the plenum chamber grille or access cover and loosen the nuts holding the drive rod ball stud to the crank arm.
Remove the 3 motor screw assemblies or nuts and take out the motor.
Inspect the sealing gaskets at the motor and screws; replace as needed.
Set the motor against the cowl and install its screws or nuts.
Reconnect the wiring and washer hoses.
Install the plenum chamber grille or access cover.
notes: Caution: the motor must be in Park before it goes on the cowl. Do not install a motor that has been dropped or hung by its drive link.

Type E non-depressed park wiper (Chevelle, Chevrolet, Corvette): blades park about 2 in. above the windshield molding; 12-volt compound-wound rectangular motor driving a helical gear, intermediate gear and pinion, and output gear and shaft carrying the crank arm. Two parallel switches control start, stop and park.
